description:
Customize the Fibonacci Retracement tool in NinjaTrader 8 to match a 'Golden Pocket' strategy. 

1. Open a Daily chart for SPY.
2. Draw a Fibonacci Retracement on the chart (anywhere visible).
3. Edit the properties of the drawn Fibonacci Retracement to:
   - Add a new level at 78.6% (0.786).
   - Remove the existing 23.6% (0.236) level.
   - Change the line color of the 61.8% (0.618) level to Red.
4. Save the workspace to persist your changes.
